newsitem.title: USA: Bergen Brunswig names Donald Roden new CEO.
newsitem.headline: Bergen Brunswig names Donald Roden new CEO.

text.p: Bergen Brunswig Corp said Friday its board elected Donald Roden, 49, as president and chief executive, effective January 15. The company also said Robert Martini, 64, would remain chairman of the board.

In addition, the company said it has created an office of the president, effective immediately. It said those chosen to serve in the new office include three Bergen executives -- Neil Dimick, Brent Martini and Charles Carpenter. The fourth is William Elliott, who has been an executive with VHA Inc, Bergen's largest health systems customer.
